parameters.query: SELECT 'new_contacts' as metric, COUNT(*) as current_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE created_at BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours' AND NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') as previous_value, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(daily_count)) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as daily_count FROM contacts WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY DATE(created_at)) sub) as avg_30d FROM contacts WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' UNION ALL SELECT 'workflow_errors' as metric, COUNT(*) as current_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_execution_stats WHERE status = 'error' AND started_at BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '8 hours' AND NOW() - INTERVAL '4 hours') as previous_value, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(cnt)) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM workflow_execution_stats WHERE status = 'error' AND started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY DATE(started_at)) sub) as avg_30d FROM workflow_execution_stats WHERE status = 'error' AND started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '4 hours' UNION ALL SELECT 'email_bounces' as metric, COUNT(*) as current_value, 0 as previous_value, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(cnt)) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM lead_activities WHERE activity_type = 'email_bounced' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY DATE(created_at)) sub) as avg_30d FROM lead_activities WHERE activity_type = 'email_bounced' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
